new_value: {"description":"Spec GCP-6.3: when a gateway loses a slot conflict (lowest IID wins), it must (1) select the next available slot, (2) emit a new slot claim for the replacement slot, and (3) broadcast updated schedule to federation peers and LoRa mesh. Currently none of these loser actions are implemented — only the winner path works. Python/Rust both accept the winning claim but neither re-claims on loss."}
